TOPIC: 1.20 ENTREPRENEURSHIP INTRODUCTIONEntrepreneurship is the act of creating and managing a business to make goods or provide services for the community. In this topic, learners will be introduced to the concept of an entrepreneur and the important role they play in society. By identifying local entrepreneurs and participating in activities such as role playing, learners begin to understand how goods and services are made, bought, and sold, and how these contribute to everyday life.
